description: Upload an image to Colour Memory for ephemeral processing. Returns image_id valid 5 minutes. Pass image_id to palette_extract or image_brief. Use for any image over 50 KB.

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded image data. Use this for locally uploaded files with no public URL. No size limit here (unlike palette_extract's image_base64).

title: Ingest Image for Processing
